title: Remote Site Operator
subtitle: Joins a new remote machine to the fleet, gives it its own certificates, copies the models across, keeps it reachable without opening any inbound door in the firewall, and retires it cleanly when it is no longer needed.
lede: Joins a new remote machine to the fleet, gives it its own certificates, copies the models across, keeps it reachable without opening any inbound door in the firewall, and retires it cleanly when it is no longer needed. You get remote hardware that behaves like the box under your desk.
who: An infrastructure lead with machines in other rooms, offices or rented data centres
author: Corey James
